title: StoreFormatConversionEvent
description: Draft event contract for store format conversion (brownfield remodeling) business events. This schema is a Stage A engineering preparation deliverable — it describes the target contract shape but does NOT assert that any producer, data source, or runtime capability currently exists. Stage B (real data integration) requires H04 human input and formal financial parameter approval.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this conversion event. Used for idempotent replay — replaying the same event_id MUST NOT cause duplicate cost/revenue entries.

event_type.description: Discriminator for event routing. Always FORMAT_CONVERSION for this contract.

store_id.description: References core.stores(store_id). The existing store undergoing format conversion.

from_format_code.description: Original store format code before conversion (e.g., ODAY_G1, ODAY_G2, ODAY_G3_COMPACT). Must reference a registered format in TargetFormatRegistry.

to_format_code.description: Target store format code after conversion (e.g., ODAY_G2, ODAY_FLAGSHIP). Must differ from from_format_code. Must reference a registered format in TargetFormatRegistry.

conversion_start_date.description: Date when remodeling/conversion work begins. Store is assumed closed for business from this date for downtime_days.

conversion_completed_date.description: Date when remodeling is completed and the store reopens in the new format. Optional — null if conversion is in progress or planned but not yet completed.

remodeling_capex.description: Total capital expenditure for the remodeling/conversion, in the tenant's base currency. Includes demolition, construction, equipment, fixtures, and fitout for the new format. Does NOT include the original greenfield capex (that belongs to the original store opening event).

downtime_days.description: Number of calendar days the store is closed during remodeling. Revenue loss = daily_baseline_revenue × downtime_days. Zero is valid only when conversion requires no closure (e.g., overnight equipment swap documented in the playbook).

residual_value.description: Salvage/residual value of equipment and fixtures from the old format that can be recovered (sold, reused, or transferred). Optional — null means the value is unknown and MUST NOT be assumed to be zero.

disposal_cost.description: Cost of disposing of old-format equipment and fixtures that cannot be salvaged. Optional — null means the cost is unknown and MUST NOT be assumed to be zero.

effective_date.description: Date when the store starts operating in the new format for financial reporting purposes. May differ from conversion_completed_date if there is a soft-opening or regulatory delay. Optional.

closure_start_date.description: Date when the store ceases revenue-generating operations. Defaults to conversion_start_date if not provided separately. Exists to support cases where a store stops trading before physical remodeling begins.

closure_end_date.description: Date when the store resumes revenue-generating operations in the new format. May differ from conversion_completed_date if there is a ramp/soft-launch period.

ramp_months.description: Number of months for the converted store to reach steady-state revenue in the new format. During ramp, revenue follows the format-specific ramp curve (RampCurveSpec). Optional — null means ramp parameters are unknown and must be requested via H04.

ramp_curve_id.description: Reference to the applicable RampCurveSpec for the post-conversion ramp-up period. If null, the default ramp curve for to_format_code is used when ramp_months is specified.

daily_baseline_revenue.description: Pre-conversion average daily revenue for downtime loss calculation. Optional — if null, the simulator must use the store's historical revenue record or mark the loss as unquantified.

conversion_reason.description: Business justification category for the conversion. Optional.

approved_by.description: Identity of the human authority who approved the conversion project. Required for Stage B production events; null in draft/planned events.

event_source.description: Identifier of the system or process that produced this event (e.g., 'store_ops_erp', 'manual_entry', 'migration_backfill'). Required for lineage tracking.

event_source_version.description: Version of the event source system or schema at the time the event was produced.

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp when this event was recorded in the system. Used for ordering and deduplication.

idempotency_key.description: Optional secondary deduplication key. If present, the system MUST treat events with the same idempotency_key as duplicates regardless of event_id.

metadata.description: Extensible metadata for future fields. Must not contain fields that belong in the top-level schema.

_design_notes.new_store_vs_conversion: This contract is strictly for brownfield format conversion of EXISTING stores. New store openings (greenfield) use the existing SimulationInput contract in modules/site_economics/domain/simulator.py. The two MUST NOT be conflated.
_design_notes.replay_idempotency: Replaying the same event_id must not cause duplicate cost entries, duplicate revenue loss calculations, or duplicate ramp applications. Consumers must implement at-least-once idempotent processing keyed on event_id.
_design_notes.missing_vs_zero: Null/missing values mean 'unknown — do not assume any value'. Zero means 'explicitly measured and confirmed to be zero'. This distinction is critical for residual_value and disposal_cost.
_design_notes.stage_b_prerequisites: Before this contract can be used in production: (1) H04 real conversion events and financial parameters must be provided, (2) core.store_format_conversions migration must be created, (3) simulator.py must support ConversionSimulationInput, (4) event replay tests must pass.
